thread:
lina (platform): running a quick idea by y'all: introduce "snapshot-scrub-mode" for short-lived canary captures. goal: keep tiny useful state for debugging without storing full plaintext. thoughts?

tom (eng-ml): sounds promising. what counts as 'useful state'? we need enough context to reproduce model failure.

lina (platform): plan: store three things only: (1) request metadata (route, model, seq_len), (2) a compact token-change summary (token-ids + counts, compressed), (3) structured redaction hints (pii_matches -> type,count,offsets) but never store raw detected spans.

priya (privacy): +1 on minimalism. two caveats: hashed-only PII is irreversible (good), but legal/audit requests need a gated replay path. any reversible flow must be controlled by an HSM-backed unwrap + legal ticket.

max (support): for triage, we sometimes need to see the offending snippet. can we return a masked preview inline: e.g., replace username with first char + **** and show domain for emails? that may be enough often.

dennis (prod): quota concern: tenants could enable canaries and flood storage. suggest per-tenant snapshot_quota_bytes and burst window. also auto-disable when quota exceeded.

infra-bot: rollout: feature/snapshot-scrub -> canary cluster scheduled

tom (eng-ml): implementation note: instead of token text, store token-ids + frequency vector + top-k tokens for changed positions (k<=3). reduces leakage and keeps signal.

priya (privacy): add: all snapshots must run an automated PII-redaction pass. if regex detects SSN/email/phone, replace with <REDACTED:TYPE>. log redaction_version and rule_hash.

lina (platform): API sketch (server enforces, header is advisory):

POST /v1/responses
Headers:
  Authorization: Bearer <$TOKEN>
  x-rw-snapshot-mode: scrub|full|none
  x-rw-inspect-reason: canary|debug
Body: {"prompt": "..."}

tom (eng-ml): note: token claim enforcement: token.claims.snapshot_allowed must gate 'scrub' creation for enterprise tokens. header can't be trusted.

max (support): console UX asks:
- show: snapshot_sample_rate, snapshot_quota_used, last_snapshot_seen, redaction_version
- allow: request unmask (async) which kicks off HSM unwrap + require 2FA + reason field

priya (privacy): unmask workflow requirements:
- operator must be in RBAC group "legal-audit"
- action creates an immutable audit entry: operator, time, ticket-id, TTL for unmasked copy
- unmasked copies auto-expire (default 7 days) and are then shredded + KMS audit logged

lina (platform): telemetry we should emit: snapshot_created_count, avg_snapshot_bytes, snapshot_redaction_hits, snapshot_unmask_requests, avg_unmask_time_ms, snapshot_quota_exhausted_events. these feed console alerts.

dennis (prod): prometheus vs trace: counters for counts, histograms for sizes/latencies. console needs alert thresholds.

tom (eng-ml): perf target: no more than 4% p99 overhead for enabling scrub-mode on a route. will prototype token-id vector + compression.

priya (privacy): final policy note: no plaintext emails, phones, SSNs in any stored blob ever. detection runs at capture time and on periodic audits.

lina (platform): action items:
- (tom) prototype compact snapshot format and perf bench (2w)
- (priya) draft unmask gating + legal workflow (this week)
- (dennis) quota + console alert mockups (end of week)
- (max) list top 10 support cases that need snippets (EoW)

infra-bot: meeting created: "snapshot-scrub design review" 11:30 PT in #eng-platform tomorrow

lina (platform): thanks all — we'll iterate on rule_hash + telemetry names in the spec. :thumbsup:
